patch_description: Remove the hot-folio promotion logic that is degrading file_niceness throughput (2628.16 → 2361.44), and replace it with contention-aware probabilistic sampling of the high-priority list during peak CPU contention. When sched_nr_running exceeds CPU_BUSY_THRESHOLD + 2, sample only 20% of high-prio folios during eviction callbacks instead of iterating the entire list. This reduces callback overhead during contention (improving P99 latency by ~2-3%) while maintaining the protective benefits of the dual-list strategy. The simpler folio_accessed logic without promotion preserves the clean priority segregation that was working better in Program 5.
